demux.audioCodecHint: Te āhua o te tuhituhi i ngā awa oro. "Tārua" ka tango i a rātou kore-ngaro me te kore whakawaehere anō; ko te kōwhiri kōdeka ka whakawaehere anō i te oro.
demux.bitmapSubtitleWarning: Kāore tēnei awa hauraro-raraunga (bitmap) e taea te huri ki tuhinga me te kore OCR, nō reira ka tangohia hei tārua .mks kore-ngaro.

demux.filtersHint: Whakamahi i ngā tātari ataata FFmpeg (tapahi, reiti anga, whakaware-ā-rawhi, whakaiti haruru, tae…) i te wa o te whakawaehere anō i te awa ataata kua kōwhiria. He kore-ngaro te "Tārua", nō reira ka puta noa ngā tātari ina whakawaehere anō te ipu whāinga i te ataata.
demux.filtersIgnoredCopy: Ka warewarehia ngā tātari ataata i te mea he "Tārua" te whāinga ataata, nā te mea e kore e taea te tārua awa kia whakawaehere anō. Kōwhiria he ipu whāinga kia whakamahia ai ngā tātari.
demux.outputDirHint: Ko te kōpaki e tuhia ai ngā awa i tangohia. Ko te taunoa ko te kōpaki o te kōnae taketake.

demux.subtitleFormatHint: Te āhua o te tuhituhi i ngā awa hauraro. "Tārua" ka tango i a rātou kore-ngaro me te kore whakawaehere anō; ko te kōwhiri hōputu ka huri i te hauraro. Kāore e taea te noho tuhinga o ngā hauraro bitmap (hei tauira PGS/DVDSUB), nō reira ka noho tārua tonu.
demux.subtitleWarningHint: Kāore e taea te whakawaehere i ngā awa hauraro bitmap (hei tauira PGS/DVDSUB) ki tuhinga me te kore OCR, nō reira ka tangohia hei tārua .mks kore-ngaro. I roto i te mahere tango, ka puta hei "Tārua".
demux.summaryHint: Kōnae putanga kotahi mō ia awa i kōwhiria, i te raupapa mahina. Ko ngā kōnae kua tapaina hei "Tārua" ka tangohia kore-ngaro; ko ngā kōnae kua tapaina hei "Huri" ka whakawaehere anō.

remux.audioSyncHint: Nekehia te rīpene oro matua ina whakaritea ki te ataata me te kore whakawaehere anō, hei tauira -0.5 mō te 0.5 hēkona tērā, 1.5 rānei mō te 1.5 hēkona ā muri.

remux.copyChapters: Tārua i ngā upoko o te taketake

remux.filtersReencodeWarning: Kāore e taea e ngā tātari ataata te mahi ki te tārua awa, nō reira ka huri ngā tātari i kōwhiria ({{count}}) i tēnei Remux ki te whakawaehere anō.
remux.outputFileHint: Te ara whāinga mō te kōnae i muri i te Remux. Ka whai te taapiri i te ipu whāinga.
remux.streamsHint: Kōwhiria ngā awa mai i te kōnae taketake hei pupuri i te putanga Remux. Ka maka ngā awa kāore i kōwhiria.
remux.subtitleCodecHint: Te kōdeka hauraro mō ngā rīpene kua whakakuhuna. Ka whakaae ngā ipu ki ngā hōputu hauraro rerekē; ko te kōwhiri hōputu e kore e taea e te ipu te pupuri ka puta te whakatūpato.
remux.subtitlesHint: Ngā kōnae hauraro ō-roto (.srt, .ass, .vtt) ka whakakuhuna ki te putanga Remux hei rīpene whakauru āpiti.
remux.thumbnailHint: He atahanga uhi ōmeka (.jpg, .jpeg, .png) ka whakakuhuna ki te kōnae i muri i te Remux. Ka piri a MKV/WebM hei awa atahanga; ka whakakuhuna a MP4/MOV hei awa ataata me te tohu attached_pic.
remux.thumbnailUnsupported: Kāore e taea e {{container}} te pupuri ūpoko. Huri ki MKV, WebM, MP4, MOV rānei kia piri ai te karakaramata.
remux.title: Remux
remux.videoFileHint: Te kōnae pāpāho taketake ka whakakōpaki anō ai ōna awa ki te ipu whāinga. Ka tāruatia ngā awa me te kore whakawaehere anō.
remux.warningsHint: Ngā pitopito kōrero kāore e ākaia ana mō te hononga o ngā awa me ngā tautuhinga kua kōwhiria ki te ipu kua kōwhiria. Ka taea tonu e ngā whakatūpato te tīmata; ka ākaia e ngā hē.
